Synthetic shell wrapper around a USTAR tar archive compressed by Python gzip.GzipFile with mtime=0 and an empty filename. The single archive member is vendor/hello.txt, containing `synthetic vendor blob\n`, with zero ownership/timestamps. Expected gzip length/SHA-256 are computed from the producer output before adding the wrapper. The CRLF fixture uses the identical payload with case and whitespace variants in its marker. No shell script or firmware bytes are executed to construct or test these fixtures. The recursive fixture targets line 1 and must be rejected.
